_about: Act Four on the v3.1 stick lock (the v3-shots-act4 pass, v3.1 round). The per-shot plan (verdicts, marks, faces, whips), the v4 id map, the post ids and the size classes are READ from Act Four v5's lock_v5.py tables (plan_py, parsed, never run), with the v4 lock's marks for the reused v4 layouts (base_lock), as the act4-v5 port reads them. The JSON `shots` entries merge over them where v3 / v3.1 moved something: marks re-anchored on new, moved or dropped lines (S3.04's jacket, S4.02's clack and Alyi's cutaway, C14's cut call, C15's second sentence, the new Tasya and Terb reads, the 2 AM restaging), the Remove click (v31-S1.08d; S1.09 now opens after it), and faces for the new speakers. Text kinds: v5's, with the v3 plates (names only), the board side's Remove notice (a toast) and Ttemme's card. The cut beats' python entries (S1.06, S1.08, S2.03, S2.04, S4.04, S4.06, S4.13c, S5.01, S7.07b, S8.09b) have no shot (the lock logs them).
